name: Cradle
source:
I looked at the sky through the fence on the roof. It was blue.
Then I looked down. It was neither too high nor too low.

The rooftop of a four-story school isn't that high.
It's just about the height you might not die by jumping from.
Then again, it's not low enough for one to jump from without hesitation.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6018]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
我透过屋顶的栅栏看着天空。它是蓝色的。
然后我低下头。它既不太高也不太低。

四层学校的屋顶并没有那么高。
这只是关于你可能不会因跳下而死亡的高度。
话又说回来，它还不够低，让人可以毫不犹豫地跳下去。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6018]NovelGame[/url]]
